title: Product Management & Marketing Intern (Summer 2027 Intern)
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Product Management & Marketing Intern will partner directly with senior product managers and global marketing leaders supporting the HyClone™ Cell Culture Media and Process Liquids & Buffers portfolio. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of biotechnology, business strategy, digital marketing, and customer experience.

Throughout the summer, you'll contribute to high-impact projects that help research institutions and biopharmaceutical companies develop life-changing therapies. You'll gain hands-on experience with product management, market analysis, ecommerce optimization, AI-powered marketing tools, and cross-functional business leadership.

This position reports to the Director of Product Management and is part of the Cell Culture Product Management team located in Logan, Utah. This role is expected to be onsite.

What You'll Do

Partner with product managers and marketing leaders on strategic initiatives that support growth of the HyClone™ portfolio.
Improve customer experience across ecommerce and digital platforms through content optimization and customer journey enhancements.
Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify emerging industry trends and customer needs.
Develop customer-facing marketing content, product literature, sales enablement materials, and promotional campaigns.
Analyze website, customer, and business performance data to generate actionable recommendations.
Explore and apply AI-enabled marketing and business tools to improve efficiency and customer engagement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Operations, R&D, and Customer Service.
Present project outcomes and recommendations to business leaders at the conclusion of the internship.

What You'll Gain

Direct mentorship from experienced product management and marketing professionals.
Exposure to the biotechnology and biopharmaceutical industry.
Experience applying business and marketing concepts in a global commercial organization.
Opportunities to build analytical, communication, project management, and leadership skills.
Networking opportunities with associates and leaders across Cytiva and Danaher.
A meaningful project with visible business impact that you can discuss in future interviews and career opportunities.

Who You Are

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Communications, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Economics, or a related field.
Expected graduation date of December 2027 or later.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to solve problems.
Comfortable working independently while collaborating within a team environment.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

It Would Be a Plus If You Have

Experience with digital marketing, ecommerce, content creation, or social media campaigns.
Familiarity with AI-powered productivity or marketing tools.
Exposure to Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or other business analytics platforms.
Experience participating in student organizations, leadership roles, internships, or team projects.
Interest in biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences, or technology-driven industries.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.
